data.one_liner: Utility to convert Web3 and Ethereum addresses to checksum format (EIP55).
data.what_it_does: Provides utility functions like toEIP55Address and toChecksumAddress to convert upper or lower case Web3/Ethereum addresses into standard EIP55 checksum addresses.
use_when: You need to format Ethereum addresses to EIP55 standard checksums.
You are working on Web3 applications in Dart or Flutter.
avoid_when: You do not need address formatting functionality.
You are using a heavy blockchain framework that already includes address checksum utilities.
strengths: Simple and lightweight utility focused on a single task.
Easy to use with straightforward function calls.
weaknesses: Very limited scope doing only EIP55 address conversion.

alternatives.name: web3dart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides complete Ethereum client capabilities including address utilities and smart contract interaction.

alternatives.name: blockchain_utils
alternatives.why_pick_it: A comprehensive crypto and blockchain utility library covering multiple networks and address formats.
